author: tcoratger
content:
Hello everyone,

This channel is dedicated to all the discussions around networking in the post quantum environment. We know that the post quantum objects and proofs are several orders of magnitude larger than pre-quantum ones and so we need to adapt and benchmark things to see what needs to be changed and what already works nicely.

On this, we have various ongoing simulations, research etc and I'm aware of this EIP proposal: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12423 and we have of course more blog post and reports that we can share here.
